title: The Wellness Membership Tier Ladder
content:
The six tiers of the Wellness Membership stand on one ladder, from the entry tier at rank 1 to the highest tier at rank 6. A tier with a lower rank is a lower tier.

| Rank | Tier | A tier change takes effect | Move to a lower tier allowed before the commitment ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open Gym Access Membership | from the next billing period | Yes |
| 2 | Aquatic Access Membership | from the next billing period | Yes |
| 3 | Wellness Essentials Membership | from the next billing period | No |
| 4 | Wellness Plus Membership | from the next billing period | No |
| 5 | Performance Membership | from the next billing period | No |
| 6 | Performance Plus Membership | from the next billing period | No |

## Training notes on the ladder

**What does "lower tier" mean for the Wellness Membership?** A tier with a lower rank on this ladder: for example the Wellness Essentials Membership (rank 3) is lower than the Wellness Plus Membership (rank 4), and the Aquatic Access Membership (rank 2) is lower than the Wellness Essentials Membership (rank 3).

**When does a tier change take effect?** On every tier, from the next billing period.

**Which column applies to a move down?** The column for the tier the member currently holds: it reads "Yes" on the Open Gym Access Membership and the Aquatic Access Membership, and "No" on the four tiers from rank 3 to rank 6.
